G4396.def: a foreteller ("prophet"); by analogy, an inspired speaker; by extension, a poet

G4352.def: to fawn or crouch to, i.e. (literally or figuratively) prostrate oneself in homage (do reverence to, adore)

G4374.gloss: bring (to, unto), deal with, do, offer (unto, up), present unto, put to
G4374.def: to bear towards, i.e. lead to, tender (especially to God), treat

G4314.gloss: about, according to , against, among, at, because of, before, between, (where-)by, for, X at thy house, in, for intent,…
G4314.def: a preposition of direction; forward to, i.e. toward (with the genitive case, the side of, i.e. pertaining to; with the dative case, by the side of, i.e. near to; usually with the accusative case, the place, time, occasion, or respect, which is the destination of the relation, i.e. whither or for which it is predicated)

G4334.gloss: (as soon as he) come (unto), come thereunto, consent, draw near, go (near, to, unto)
G4334.def: to approach, i.e. (literally) come near, visit, or (figuratively) worship, assent to

G4350.def: to strike at, i.e. surge against (as water); specially, to stub on, i.e. trip up (literally or figuratively)

G4336.def: to pray to God, i.e. supplicate, worship

G4337.gloss: (give) attend(-ance, -ance at, -ance to, unto), beware, be given to, give (take) heed (to unto); have regard
G4337.def: (figuratively) to hold the mind (3563 implied) towards, i.e. pay attention to, be cautious about, apply oneself to, adhere to

G4383.gloss: (outward) appearance, X before, countenance, face, fashion, (men's) person, presence
G4383.def: the front (as being towards view), i.e. the countenance, aspect, appearance, surface; by implication, presence, person

G4369.gloss: add, again, give more, increase, lay unto, proceed further, speak to any more
G4369.def: to place additionally, i.e. lay beside, annex, repeat

G4395.def: to foretell events, divine, speak under inspiration, exercise the prophetic office

G4341.def: to call toward oneself, i.e. summon, invite

G4328.gloss: (be in) expect(-ation), look (for), when looked, tarry, wait for
G4328.def: to anticipate (in thought, hope or fear); by implication, to await

G4377.def: to sound towards, i.e. address, exclaim, summon

G4340.gloss: dur-(eth) for awhile, endure for a time, for a season, temporal
G4340.def: for the occasion only, i.e. temporary

G4355.def: to take to oneself, i.e. use (food), lead (aside), admit (to friendship or hospitality)

G4339.def: an arriver from a foreign region, i.e. (specially), an acceder (convert) to Judaism ("proselyte")

G4302.def: to say beforehand, i.e. predict, forewarn

G4351.def: to roll towards, i.e. block against

G4342.gloss: attend (give self) continually (upon), continue (in, instant in, with), wait on (continually)
G4342.def: to be earnest towards, i.e. (to a thing) to persevere, be constantly diligent, or (in a place) to attend assiduously all the exercises, or (to a person) to adhere closely to (as a servitor)

G4363.def: to fall towards, i.e. (gently) prostrate oneself (in supplication or homage), or (violently) to rush upon (in storm)

G4344.def: something for the head, i.e. a cushion

G4358.def: to moor to, i.e. (by implication) land at

G4370.def: to run towards, i.e. hasten to meet or join

G4327.def: to admit (to intercourse, hospitality, credence, or (figuratively) endurance); by implication, to await (with confidence or patience)

G4398.def: a female foreteller or an inspired woman

G4317.def: to lead towards, i.e. (transitively) to conduct near (summon, present), or (intransitively) to approach

G4320.def: to ascend farther, i.e. be promoted (take an upper (more honorable) seat)

G4390.def: to run forward, i.e. outstrip, precede

G4333.def: to work additionally, i.e. (by implication) acquire besides

G4371.def: something eaten in addition to bread, i.e. a relish (specially, fish; compare G3795 (ὀψάριον))

G4362.def: to fasten to, i.e. (specially), to impale (on a cross)

G4308.def: to behold in advance, i.e. (actively) to notice (another) previously, or (middle voice) to keep in (one's own) view

G4391.def: to exist before, i.e. (adverbially) to be or do something previously

G4381.def: an accepter of a face (individual), i.e. (specially), one exhibiting partiality

G4311.gloss: accompany, bring (forward) on journey (way), conduct forth
G4311.def: to send forward, i.e. escort or aid in travel

G4345.def: to give a common lot to, i.e. (figuratively) to associate with

G4326.def: to require additionally, i.e. want further

G4357.gloss: abide still, be with, cleave unto, continue in (with)
G4357.def: to stay further, i.e. remain in a place, with a person; figuratively, to adhere to, persevere in

G4389.def: to turn forward for oneself, i.e. encourage

G4376.def: presentation; concretely, an oblation (bloodless) or sacrifice

G4385.def: to protend, i.e. tie prostrate (for scourging)

G4307.def: forethought, i.e. provident care or supply

G4354.def: to talk to, i.e. converse with

G4388.def: to place before, i.e. (for oneself) to exhibit; (to oneself) to propose (determine)

G4309.def: to limit in advance, i.e. (figuratively) predetermine

G4348.def: a stub, i.e. (figuratively) occasion of apostasy

G4306.def: to consider in advance, i.e. look out for beforehand (actively, by way of maintenance for others; middle voice by way of circumspection for oneself)

G4322.def: to fill up further, i.e. furnish fully

G4323.def: to lay up in addition, i.e. (middle voice and figuratively) to impart or (by implication) to consult

G4301.def: to take in advance, i.e. (literally) eat before others have an opportunity; (figuratively) to anticipate, surprise

G4338.def: to peg to, i.e. spike fast

G4316.def: to address, i.e. salute by name

G4380.def: to favor an individual, i.e. show partiality

G4303.def: to be a witness in advance i.e. predict
